summary: Manasquan owns the week — a prime E swell loads up Sunday and peaks Mon-Tue, with Tuesday the standout: chest-high-plus at 7s with offshore-to-light wind, clean enough to justify the drive. Rockaway is small but surfable all week and gets its own decent Mon-Tue window if you'd rather stay home, while Ditch and Matunuck stay marginal and Lido just mirrors Rockaway smaller. Everything blows out Thursday on 20-28mph wind, so bank the good stuff early week.
